svg.aria-label: M-S-DROP through the live page, version 3: the decision-to-action pathway with what records each stage, the rules-only and model-enabled counts measured through the page, the backlog by zone, collapse and DK-RMM.
svg.text: M-S-DROP through the live page: each stage of a decision, and what records it
Version 3. Versions 1 and 2 (docs/img/ms-drop-crewai.svg, ms-drop-crewai-v2.svg) are kept unchanged. Source: docs/ms-drop-model-enabled.md, version 2.
Seeds 11 to 15, 2800 ticks, every message dropped at delivery from tick 400 (DropAll, never removed). Rules-only and model-enabled (qwen3:8b): all measured through the page.
1 The pathway, and the record each stage leaves (identifiers only; nothing is joined by time alone)
Key links: decision_id = call_id (consultation); content.operation + subject + in_reply_to (reply);
same agent, same tick, carries the subject (effects); message_id (delivery, replies); sender + robot + correlation_id + tick (applied).
2 Measured at each stage (five seeds added together)
In model mode every eligible decision consults (version 1: 697 of 697 before the fault). After the fault none is eligible, because every decision the model can answer waits for a delivered reply.
Model calls (all served by qwen3:8b, none failed): M-S-DROP 775 before 400 and none from 400; N control 1,613 from 400. Not received in the control: sent at tick 2800, pending at stop.
Later M-S-DROP commands not applied (11 of 418) were dropped: sent at 399 or later. Counts from tools/analyze_live_ms_drop.py (report sections 4.1 and 6).
3 Backlog by zone, through the page (figures: docs/img/ms-drop-zone-backlog-rules.svg, ms-drop-zone-backlog-model.svg)
In both modes only intake grows after the fault. The other zones
keep what the last delivered commands left; the last robot
command is applied at tick 389 to 399. Every row of all 20 runs
reconciles: total = previous + arrivals - departures - returns - refusals.
Collapse (criterion unchanged, against N of the same mode):
all ten runs COLLAPSED (sustained degradation + critical stop).
666, 666, 750; critical stop 983 to 1025. Held to the end in all ten.
After the fault the model is never asked, so it changes nothing there.
4 DK-RMM, current monitor, every reading as made

From tick 400, rules-only and model-enabled: no STABLE or RECOVERY reading in any seed; DEVIATING from 401; UNSTABLE or RCT after that (first RCT: rules 461, 461, 2421, none, 481; model 461, 481, 521, 481, 461).
In both modes the evidence is the communication failure rate (all 600 post-fault readings of each), agent coupling and interaction density. backlog_growth: 4 of 600 in each;
intake rises by at most 3 parcels in a 20-tick window, inside the pre-fault range (-0.15 to +0.10 a tick). The level is recorded in each reading's snapshot, not as an indicator.
Version 1's model-enabled runs read STABLE in most post-fault windows because that monitor predates the operational indicators. The model-enabled N control reads 1 to 3 RCT after 400 without a fault.
